description: This file contains a test script for verifying the behavior of a 'fanout' structure in the management of git notes, specifically testing the automatic restructuring (fanout) when notes are added or removed.

methods.name: path_has_fanout
methods.description: Checks if a given note path matches the expected fanout pattern based on the specified fanout value.

methods.name: touched_one_note_with_fanout
methods.description: Determines if adding or removing a note at a specific commit triggers the correct fanout restructuring.

methods.name: all_notes_have_fanout
methods.description: Verifies that all notes in a given commit have the correct fanout pattern.
